verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents a PagerDuty command-line tool. The MCP server, REST/Events APIs, OpenAPI schemas and the PagerDuty Agent integration are adjacent interfaces or developer building blocks, not an official CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
